title: The Forbidden Journey (first full midpoint attempt)

intro.speaker: NARRATOR
intro.text: Nerelle is waiting in the water below the quay.

intro.speaker: NARRATOR
intro.text: A folded chart sits on a dry ledge within her reach, weighted down with a smooth stone.

intro.speaker: NERELLE
intro.text: “Before you ask: yes, this map is mine. No, I did not steal it.”

intro.speaker: NERELLE
intro.text: “The court has ruled that it is an inconvenient thing for me to own.”

intro.speaker: PLAYER
intro.text: “Is this the part where the warning says ‘forbidden journey’?”

intro.speaker: NERELLE
intro.text: “It says ‘unsanctioned surface observation.’ Written large enough, that sounds almost respectable.”

intro.speaker: NARRATOR
intro.text: She unfolds the chart. Spots near the quay and along the gardens canal are circled in neat ink.

intro.speaker: NARRATOR
intro.text: From each one, you could hear a market without leaving the water.

intro.speaker: NARRATOR
intro.text: One circle is labeled *bakery (smell only)*.

intro.speaker: NERELLE
intro.text: “I know these tides. I have guided emergency supplies through these channels.”

intro.speaker: NERELLE
intro.text: “But when I ask to come here because I want to, the answer changes.”

intro.speaker: PLAYER
intro.text: “Your court doesn’t want you to go?”

intro.speaker: NERELLE
intro.text: “They want me safe. They also want me available whenever a council member discovers another urgent meeting.”

intro.speaker: NERELLE
intro.text: “Both are reasonable. Added together, they come to every hour I have.”

intro.speaker: NARRATOR
intro.text: Overhead, a courier crosses a bridge under a stack of documents taller than his head. The top sheet escapes and drops toward the canal.

intro.speaker: NARRATOR
intro.text: Nerelle catches it before it sinks.

intro.speaker: NERELLE
intro.text: “Marked *urgent*. So the surface defends itself with paperwork too. I feel at home already.”

intro.speaker: PLAYER
intro.text: “Why tell me about this now?”

intro.speaker: NERELLE
intro.text: “Because I trust you. That makes it harder.”

intro.speaker: NERELLE
intro.text: “Everyone has an opinion about what I should do. I wanted to hear yours.”

intro.speaker: NERELLE
intro.text: “And I am afraid it will be one more order, dressed up as kindness.”

intro.speaker: PLAYER
intro.text: “What do you want?”

intro.speaker: NERELLE
intro.text: “To learn how people live above the water. To stay answerable to everyone below it who relies on me.”

intro.speaker: NERELLE
intro.text: “And for the choice to be mine.”

intro.speaker: NARRATOR
intro.text: She waits in the current with the chart between you. There is a pencil on top of it.

options.labelText: “Then let’s plan it. Your route, your timing. We find a safe stop, agree what to tell the court, and reschedule if the tide or council objects.”

branch.speaker: NERELLE
branch.text: “You did not start with what I am allowed to do.”

branch.speaker: PLAYER
branch.text: “Well, you know this water better than I ever will. I can do the surface bits, if you want them.”

branch.speaker: NERELLE
branch.text: “Then here is my proposal. First, I finish my scheduled hearings.”

branch.speaker: NERELLE
branch.text: “Second, I tell the appropriate attendants where I will be.”

branch.speaker: NERELLE
branch.text: “Third, I explore the garden canal. For no reason at all, except that I want to.”

branch.speaker: PLAYER
branch.text: “And if somebody calls a private outing scandalous?”

branch.speaker: NERELLE
branch.text: “I will ask whether they prefer their scandals alphabetized.”

branch.speaker: NARRATOR
branch.text: She traces the canal on the chart. You point out where a walkway runs along the bank.

branch.speaker: NERELLE
branch.text: “Not there. The current is too swift by that bridge. You would spend the visit waving at me as I went past.”

branch.speaker: NARRATOR
branch.text: She moves your finger two bridges down, to where the water slows.

branch.speaker: NERELLE
branch.text: “I was afraid you would turn this into a daring rescue.”

branch.speaker: NERELLE
branch.text: “Nobody needs to carry me away from my life. I would like room to live in it.”

branch.speaker: PLAYER
branch.text: “No daring rescue. I’ll cancel the horse.”

branch.speaker: NERELLE
branch.text: “You do not have a horse.”

branch.speaker: PLAYER
branch.text: “I was going to borrow one.”

branch.speaker: NARRATOR
branch.text: You follow the canal together, you on the path and she in the water beside you.

branch.speaker: NARRATOR
branch.text: She points out which bridges echo, and which only pretend to.

options.labelText: “You shouldn’t have to deal with any of this. I’ll get you away from the court before anyone can object.”

branch.speaker: NERELLE
branch.text: “Away from the court? Those are my people.”

branch.speaker: PLAYER
branch.text: “I just meant I’d get you free.”

branch.speaker: NERELLE
branch.text: “Free to follow your plan instead of theirs?”

branch.speaker: NARRATOR
branch.text: She folds the chart, slides it back under its stone, and does not unfold it again.

options.labelText: “Your court has a point. It’s risky up here. Maybe stop asking to visit.”

branch.speaker: NERELLE
branch.text: “I know the risks. I listed them on the back.”

branch.speaker: NARRATOR
branch.text: She turns the chart over. The list is longer than the route.

branch.speaker: PLAYER
branch.text: “I just don’t want you to get hurt.”

branch.speaker: NERELLE
branch.text: “Your worry is welcome. It does not outrank me.”

branch.speaker: NARRATOR
branch.text: She lets the chart drift back against the stone and leaves for her hearings. Every circle stays where it is.
